summary: Tested both features from this session end-to-end. (1) Feed Program cloud-sync warning banner + retry: PASSED. Blocked PUT /api/feed-program/state via Playwright network interception, made 3 genuine double-click cell edits — after 4 blocked PUTs the persistent red banner appeared with data-testid='cloud-sync-warning-banner' containing exact copy 'Cloud backup isnt working right now — your edits are saved on this device only. Check your internet connection.' + Retry now button (data-testid='cloud-sync-retry-button'), header showed 'Not backed up' indicator (data-testid='header-cloud-sync-warning'). Unblocked network + clicked Retry now -> both banner and header indicator disappeared. Confirmed genuine dblclick-to-edit works when input focus is verified (activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT'). (2) Ops Dashboard mortality trend: PASSED. KPI 'MORTALITY (7 DAYS)' tile visible with computed sum, farm card mortality-panel-<slug> shows Today/7d with correct data-testids, sparkline SVG has 14 bars with correct color coding (gray/green/amber/red). (3) Feed Program state PUT/GET round-trip + anti-corruption 409 guard + forceOverwrite bypass all pass via pytest. Cleaned up test-seeded morts data and restored the pre-test Feed Program snapshot on the default (Double B Farm) farm to protect the just-launched production data. 6/6 pytest passed.

minor.issue: POST with a new slug (e.g. 'test-bbm-<ts>') returned 200 but did NOT create the farm — the request was silently coerced to writing against the caller's existing farm (default). Effect: my test's temp farm mort seed rows landed on farmId='default' instead of the temp slug. May be an intentional 1-user-1-farm guard (see Feb 2026 comment 'strict 1-user-1-farm'), but if so it should return 4xx with a clear error instead of 200 so tests/callers can't accidentally cross-contaminate the current session's farm.

action_items: Investigate POST /api/farms behavior: creating a new farm slug via API silently landed data under the caller's existing farm instead of returning an error (see backend minor issue). Not a regression for THIS session's features but worth fixing before onboarding a second grower.

Consider adding a farm-scoped assertion inside POST /api/integrations/morts that the caller actually has access/ownership of the ?farm= slug in a way that returns 4xx if the slug doesn't exist, rather than silently upserting.
critical_code_review_comments: Feed Program App.tsx is 14,444 lines — hard limit exceeded per code-review guideline (>700). Not blocking this session but flagging for a future modularization pass.

performFeedProgramSave() correctly resets cloudSyncFailCountRef.current on both 2xx success AND 409 corruption-guard — good, prevents false 'Not backed up' alarms when the corruption guard fires legitimately.

flushIfPending() correctly only fires when autoSaveTimerRef.current is non-null, avoiding a spurious PUT on every tab-hide when no edits are pending — verified via 6 dispatchEvent(visibilitychange/pagehide) rounds where no PUTs fired before the first real edit.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded 3 morts entries (2026-09-15,17,18 on default farm) — DELETED afterward via DELETE /api/integrations/morts. Temporarily wrote 3 cell edits ('11','22','33' in SILO column via genuine UI edits) on default farm's Feed Program state — RESTORED afterward from snapshot 337ace87-4014-4836-a856-e3bb1a68e6f1 via POST /api/feed-program/history/<snap>/restore. Verified final state is clean (no test values remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The banner logic requires 2+ consecutive PUT failures — genuine cell edits work via Playwright when you dblclick a cell in `table tbody tr` then verify document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT' before typing. Use page.route to abort PUT /api/feed-program/state. Feed Program loads at /?farm=<slug> not /feed-program. POST /api/farms silently ignores new slugs and writes to caller's existing farm — do NOT rely on temp farm isolation for destructive tests; instead snapshot/restore the default farm's Feed Program state before/after (via /api/feed-program/history and /api/feed-program/history/<id>/restore), and clean up morts entries via DELETE /api/integrations/morts?farm=default&date=<YYYY-MM-DD>. Owner magic link sets cookie via browser navigation but also works with `curl -c cookies.txt` for API-only tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this session's two features. Both work as specified. The only anomaly (POST /api/farms silently no-op for new slug) is pre-existing behavior unrelated to this session.
